I’m sorry—I don’t have the capability to pull up‑to‑date weather forecasts directly from an online service right now. Below are a few ways you can obtain exactly the hourly forecast you’re looking for: | Service | How to Use | |---------|------------| | **Open-Meteo** | – You can build a URL yourself:
`https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?
&latitude=37.8651&longitude=-119.5383
&hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation_probability,presure_surface_level,
&start_date={today}&end_date={today+9}`
This will return JSON containing hourly values for each day. | | **NOAA Climate Data Online (CDO)** | Search “Yosemite” or enter latitude/longitude into their *Forecast* section. | | **AccuWeather / Weather Underground** | Enter `37.8651,-119.5383` into the search box; both sites offer detailed hourly tables for the next week plus extended outlooks. | ### Quick Example Using Open‑Meteo If you paste the following link into your browser (replace `{today}` with today’s ISO date, e.g., 2026‑05‑18): ``` https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast? latitude=37.8651& longitude=-119.5383& hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation_probability& start_date=2026-05-18& end_date=2026-05-27& timezone=auto ``` you’ll receive something like: ```json { "hourly": { "time":[...], "temperature_2m":[ ... ], "windspeed_10m":[ ... ], "precipitation_probability":[ ... ] } } ``` Each array aligns by index—so `time[0]`, `temperature_2m[0]`, etc., all refer to the same hour. --- #### If you’d rather avoid coding… Most consumer apps let you input coordinates or simply drop a pin on a map: - **Apple Weather app** → tap the globe icon → choose “Add Location” → paste the coordinates. - **Google Maps** → click the location → “What’s here?” → scroll down to “weather”. These interfaces usually show a daily summary plus an expandable list of hourly readings for the coming 48–72 hours. For longer horizons (up to 10 days), look under “Extended Forecast” or similar tabs. Let me know if you'd like help interpreting the raw JSON once you've fetched it!
